from.place: 09N5 proof, the reduction from a semilocal Dedekind domain to the localizations at its maximal ideals

title: Localization of a Dedekind domain at a maximal ideal is a DVR
statement: Let B be a Dedekind domain (a Noetherian integrally closed domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]) and let m be a maximal ideal of B. Then the localization B_m is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring].
